name: std::packaged_task<R(Args...)>::get_future
intro:
Returns a future which shares the same shared state as *this.

get_future can be called only once for each packaged_task.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A future which shares the same shared state as *this.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
std::future_error on the following error conditions:

The shared state has already been retrieved via a call to get_future. The error category is set to future_already_retrieved.
 *this has no shared state. The error category is set to no_state.

examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
